run_deformable_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation with deformable soft body torus and gravity
load_soft_body: create a Neo-Hookean soft body from an OBJ mesh with configurable mass and damping
configure_visual_shape: change the visual shape color and texture of a loaded soft body object
set_physics_parameters: set physics engine parameters like sparse SDF voxel size for collision detection
step_simulation_loop: run a continuous simulation loop that steps physics and captures camera images
